_comment: License policy for scripts/check_licenses.py. Every exception needs a reason; see docs/license-verification.md.

embedded_build_tools.pyinstaller: Its bootloader is linked into the standalone npm and Windows portable binaries.
embedded_build_tools.pyinstaller-hooks-contrib: Its runtime hooks are copied into the standalone npm and Windows portable binaries.

colorama.reason: Metadata only has the generic 'BSD License' classifier; the bundled LICENSE file is the 3-clause BSD text.

exceptiongroup.reason: Installed only on Python < 3.11; upstream LICENSE is MIT.

jinja2.reason: Metadata only has the generic 'BSD License' classifier; the bundled LICENSE file is the 3-clause BSD text.

macholib.reason: PyInstaller build dependency on macOS only; upstream LICENSE is MIT.

nvidia-ml-py.reason: Metadata says only 'BSD' and the wheel ships no license file; the pynvml source header is the 3-clause BSD text.

pefile.reason: PyInstaller build dependency on Windows only; metadata License is MIT.

prompt-toolkit.reason: Metadata only has the generic 'BSD License' classifier; the bundled LICENSE file is the 3-clause BSD text.

pyinstaller.reason: Metadata is free text; COPYING.txt is GPL-2.0-or-later plus the PyInstaller bootloader exception.

pyinstaller-hooks-contrib.reason: LICENSE: standard (build-time) hooks are GPL-2.0-or-later, runtime hooks bundled into executables are Apache-2.0.

pywin32-ctypes.reason: PyInstaller build dependency on Windows only; metadata License is BSD-3-Clause.

scipy.reason: Metadata License field holds the whole license text: SciPy itself is BSD-3-Clause, followed by the licenses of libraries its wheels bundle. Development/training-only, never shipped.

tomli.reason: Installed only on Python < 3.11; upstream LICENSE is MIT.

certifi.reason: File-level copyleft. omm uses the CA bundle unmodified, so only certifi's own files stay under MPL-2.0; the notice and license text travel with the package.

pyinstaller.reason: The bootloader exception grants unlimited permission to embed the compiled bootloader and distribute the result under any terms. PyInstaller itself is not shipped or modified.

pyinstaller-hooks-contrib.reason: Only the Apache-2.0 runtime hooks end up inside the binaries; the GPL hooks run on the build machine and are not distributed.

notes.certifi: file-level copyleft; does not affect this project's license
notes.pyinstaller: bootloader exception; only the bootloader is embedded
notes.pyinstaller-hooks-contrib: only Apache-2.0 runtime hooks are embedded
